# Qoopia

> A lasting memory for your AI agents, on your computer or your own server. Keep context, find knowledge and share selectively with Qoopia.

Each page exists in English and Russian with the same content. Full text for AI assistants: https://qoopia.ai/llms-full.txt

## Current release

- Qoopia 5.0.25, released 2026-11-11 (source 8b13ea6). Machine-readable manifest: https://qoopia.ai/release.json
- macOS Apple Silicon, DMG: https://qoopia.ai/download/mac (signed file: https://github.com/qoopia/qoopia-downloads/releases/download/v5.0.25/qoopia-5.0.25-darwin-arm64.dmg), SHA-256 028c852a2e7b2b25724fd9a2a826997551f78fa3fba2f898b0d06343e2fe16ea
- Linux x64, TAR.GZ: https://qoopia.ai/download/linux (signed file: https://github.com/qoopia/qoopia-downloads/releases/download/v5.0.25/qoopia-5.0.25-linux-x64.tar.gz), SHA-256 3586642b734b51c8150fa8af06ff2cbb7b428d90c157d49d747f84915e69580e

## Requirements

- Mac: Apple Silicon Mac, macOS 15.0 or newer. Intel Macs and Windows are not supported.
- Linux: Linux x64 with glibc 2.34 or newer. Not every Linux distribution is supported. The ps command (procps) must be installed. Run as a normal user, not root.
- No separate Bun, Docker or Ollama. Cloud model features need internet access and your own supported subscription.
- iPhone: a free TestFlight beta (iOS 17+) that opens the dashboard of a server installation reachable over HTTPS. A Mac or Linux installation keeps its dashboard on that computer.

## Install

1. Download the package for your computer and check its SHA-256.
2. Mac: open the DMG, move Qoopia to Applications and open it. Linux: extract the TAR.GZ and run ./qoopia open; to keep it running without a terminal, run ./qoopia service install --commit, and on a server also loginctl enable-linger $USER.
3. Sign in with Google or email, then connect your agents in Connections.

A local Codex or Claude Code session can do this for you: https://qoopia.ai/docs#agent-install

## Works with

- Claude Code and Codex: memory tools and native session capture.
- Claude Desktop on macOS.
- Claude in a browser and ChatGPT Web/Desktop through external HTTPS access prepared in Connections. ChatGPT last passed real-client acceptance on 15 September 2026; the current consent flow has not been re-verified since.
- Other MCP clients with a separate agent identity.

## What agents get

- Canons: rules for a workspace, an agent or a project that Qoopia loads into the agent's context itself, always-on ones at session start and contextual ones when their triggers match; the owner can review and retire them on the Canon page.
- Night review: an agent with the dreamer role, run on its own schedule, proposes new rules from recent work; nothing becomes a canon until the owner accepts it.
- Handoff between Claude Code and Codex: with shared context on, a new session can pick up the last 7 days of work started in the other tool (summary, last requests, changed files).
- Tools: eight core tools at connection; tool_search finds the rest, and qoopia_execute combines read-only searches and reads in one isolated call. Writes stay separate calls.
- Search: keyword and built-in embedding search run locally without a model. Model judgement of results runs only when an agent asks for it; an optional reranker is off by default.

## Price and license

Qoopia is free; its source is MIT-licensed. Model subscriptions and server hosting are separate costs.
